    Isomorphisms between objects of the additive envelope Mat_ 𝒞 #

    An object of Mat_ 𝒞 is the direct sum of its entries, so it is determined up to isomorphism by its entries up to reindexing: it is isomorphic to its reindexing along a bijection, to any object with entrywise equal entries, and, with a single index, to the single object given by its entry.
